info.name: Syntage Accounts Payable Insight DS MX SAT Certificates API

params.name: id[lt]
params.description: Collection cursor pointer to the next page

params.name: id[gt]
params.description: Collection cursor pointer to the previous page

params.name: validFrom[before]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity start date (less than or equal `<=`)

params.name: validFrom[strictly_before]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity start date (less than `<`)

params.name: validFrom[after]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity start date (greater than or equal `>=`)

params.name: validFrom[strictly_after]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity start date (greater than `>`)

params.name: validTo[before]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity end date (less than or equal `<=`)

params.name: validTo[strictly_before]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity end date (less than `<`)

params.name: validTo[after]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity end date (greater than or equal `>=`)

params.name: validTo[strictly_after]
params.description: Filter certificates by validity end date (greater than `>`)

params.name: order[validFrom]
params.description: Order certificates by validity start date

params.name: order[validTo]
params.description: Order certificates by validity end date

params.name: serialNumber
params.description: Filter certificates by serial number (supports partial matching)

items.docs:
List SAT certificates associated with an entity.
These digital certificates are used for electronic signatures and digital sealing in Mexico's tax system.

Retrieve a SAT certificate by ID.
The `file` property references the certificate file. Use the file download endpoint to retrieve the certificate content.
